description: Add missing READMEs and rewrite all existing READMEs with warm, detailed, human tone. No em dashes anywhere.
steps: Create driftguard-gitops/projects/README.md explaining the AppProject security model: what each project file does (platform-addons, observability, security, workloads), the default-deny principle, source/destination/resource boundaries, RBAC config, and ArgoCD declarative configuration. Reference the actual files: platform-addons.yaml, observability.yaml, security.yaml, workloads.yaml, argocd-config.yaml, argocd-rbac.yaml.

Rewrite the root README.md (/projects/sandbox/DriftGuard/README.md) with warmer, more welcoming tone. Keep technical accuracy. No em dashes.
Rewrite driftguard-infra/README.md with more detail, warmer tone, better newcomer guidance. Keep all technical accuracy.
Rewrite driftguard-gitops/README.md with warmer, more welcoming tone. Add more context for newcomers.
Rewrite demo-service/README.md with warmer tone, more detail on local setup.
Rewrite driftguard-gitops/bootstrap/README.md to be warmer and more accessible.
Run a global grep for any em dash characters (U+2014) to confirm none were introduced
Run all 38 tests again to confirm nothing is broken
